dt_albatross_story: A man walks into a restaurant, orders albatross soup, takes one sip, and then kills himself.
dt_albatross_solution: He had been shipwrecked with his wife years ago. Starving, the others gave him 'albatross soup'. Now tasting real albatross, he realized he had eaten his wife back then.
dt_shoes_story: A woman buys a new pair of shoes. That night, she dies.
dt_shoes_solution: She was the assistant to a knife thrower in a circus. She bought high heels, making her taller. Blindfolded, he threw the knives at her usual height and killed her.
